## Hinge · What does this equation describe? {#fv7-hinge .fv-lesson .sphere-lesson }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="1" class="hinge numeric-choices"><div class="hinge-question"><p>For a variable position vector <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{r}"></span> in three dimensions,</p><div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="(\underset{\sim}{r}-\underset{\sim}{c})\cdot(\underset{\sim}{r}-\underset{\sim}{c})=16,\qquad \underset{\sim}{c}=\begin{bmatrix}1\\-2\\3\end{bmatrix}"></span></div><p>Which locus does this describe?</p></div><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span>A sphere with centre <span data-math="(1,-2,3)"></span> and radius <span data-math="4"></span>.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span>A sphere with centre <span data-math="(1,-2,3)"></span> and radius <span data-math="16"></span>.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>A sphere with centre <span data-math="(-1,2,-3)"></span> and radius <span data-math="4"></span>.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>All points inside or on the sphere with centre <span data-math="(1,-2,3)"></span> and radius <span data-math="4"></span>.</span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>1.</strong> The squared distance from <span data-math="(1,-2,3)"></span> is <span data-math="16"></span>, so the distance is <span data-math="4"></span>. Equality describes the surface.</div></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Additional diagnostic question</div>

::: {.notes}
Correct option 1. (r−c)·(r−c)=|r−c|²=16 implies |r−c|=4, centre c=(1,−2,3). Distractor 2 confuses radius squared with radius; 3 reverses the signs of the fixed centre coordinates; 4 treats an equality as an inequality. Ready: move to cross-sections. Divided: rewrite as |r−c|²=16 and revote. Needs explanation: revisit the fixed-distance sphere and compare points at distances 3,4,5. Everyone responds simultaneously with 1–4 fingers using the shared routine. Default 60 seconds, adjustable duration, Start/Pause/Resume and Reset. The answer is hidden until deliberate teacher reveal; timer expiry alone must not reveal it.
:::
